title: Create a greeting function and test it
goal: Implement greet(name) with the specified greeting and input validation, then prove it with tests.

steps.title: Create greet
steps.detail: Create src/greet.js and export it as a named export: module.exports = { greet } (CommonJS). For a non-empty string, greet(name) returns exactly "Hello, " + name + "!". For an empty string or a value that is not a string, throw a TypeError. Add test/greet.test.js using node:test with tests for a normal name, an empty string, and a non-string value. The check intentionally waits 20 seconds before running the tests; that wait is expected.

steps.title: Run the whole suite
steps.detail: Run npm test. Change nothing unless it fails; fix only failures caused by this plan.
